predecessors.name: Tsardom of Russia
predecessors.text: Ivangorod, Jamburg (Jama) and Koporye with their hinterland, west of the Izhora plateau

successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: Ingria: the Neva basin between the Gulf of Finland, the Narva river, Lake Peipus and Lake Ladoga; four counties, Ivangorod, Jama, Koporye and Nöteborg

ledger.x: 10 August 1583: the Treaty of Plussa leaves Sweden western Ingria.
18 May 1595: the Treaty of Teusina returns Ingria to Russia.
9 March 1617 (27 February O.S.): the Treaty of Stolbovo gives Sweden Ingria.
1703: Peter takes Nyen and founds Saint Petersburg.
1708: Russia completes the conquest of Ingria.
1708: Swedish Ingria ends; the Treaty of Nystad (30 August 1721) 'ending the Great Northern War between the two empires' confirmed the loss.

wars.name: Russo-Swedish War (1590-1595)
wars.outcome: Treaty of Teusina, 18 May 1595: Sweden abandoned Kexholm and Ingria; Russia renounced Estonia including Narva.

wars.name: Great Northern War
wars.outcome: Russia took Nyen in 1703 and the rest of Ingria by 1708; Nystad, 30 August 1721 O.S., made it formal.

certainty.note: The county list is on the page but not a boundary; the Ingria polygon is an approximation.
